name: Eshanosaurus
isnote: Described as the earliest therizinosaur (Xu et al. 2001); Barrett (2009) argued it may be a sauropodomorph.
sum: Early Jurassic dinosaur from Yunnan known only from a lower jaw, possibly the oldest therizinosaur.
holotype: IVPP V11579, three fragments of a left lower jaw with teeth, Dull Purplish Beds, Lower Lufeng Formation, Yunnan, China.
biology: Its teeth resemble those of therizinosaurs, but their sauropodomorph-like features have made its identity controversial.
author: Xu et al. 2001

sources.text: X. Xu, X. Zhao, and J. M. Clark. 2001. A new therizinosaur from the Lower Jurassic Lower Lufeng Formation of Yunnan, China. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 21(3):477-483
